note: Tier ladder by lifetime Lazer Points. Perks stack: each tier includes everything below it. Tune thresholds here.

tiers.name: Bronze
tiers.perk: Tier badge and a name color on every leaderboard

tiers.name: Silver
tiers.perk: Pin up to 3 achievement badges to your leaderboard row

tiers.name: Gold
tiers.perk: Vote on which queued game ships next

tiers.name: Platinum
tiers.perk: Early access to every new game

tiers.name: Diamond
tiers.perk: Beta builds before early access, plus your name on the credits wall

tiers.name: Legend
tiers.perk: Founding Player frame on every leaderboard, plus everything above

tiers.name: Ascendant
tiers.perk: Animated glow on your name across the arcade

tiers.name: Eternal
tiers.perk: Choose a custom name color of your own

tiers.name: Transcendent
tiers.perk: A one-of-a-kind frame and a permanent spot in the Hall of Fame
